# Typster v0.7.2 - Table of Contents

Elixir wrapper for Typst document preparation system

## Pages

- [Typster](https://typster.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- Core API
  - [Typster](https://typster.hexdocs.pm/Typster.md): High-level API for rendering Typst templates to PDF, SVG, and PNG formats.

- Exceptions
  - [Typster.CompileError](https://typster.hexdocs.pm/Typster.CompileError.md): Exception raised when Typst compilation fails.

- Native Interface
  - [Typster.Native](https://typster.hexdocs.pm/Typster.Native.md): Native Implemented Functions (NIFs) for Typster.
